title: Zesty Syrian Chicken Flatbread
description: A comforting flatbread topped with zesty chicken and herbs, delivering a burst of Syrian flavor. The dough is quick to knead and the chicken stays juicy and high protein.
instructions: In a bowl, combine flour, salt, pepper, cumin, and coriander.
Add warm water and olive oil, then knead until a smooth dough forms.
Cover the dough and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, slice the chicken breast into thin strips and season with salt, pepper, and a splash of lemon juice.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and cook the chicken until golden and cooked through, about 6 minutes.
Spread the dough onto a parchment-lined baking sheet and roll it into a flat shape.
Spoon the yogurt over the dough, then arrange the cooked chicken strips evenly across the surface.
Sprinkle minced garlic, chopped parsley, and a drizzle of olive oil over the toppings.
Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 10 minutes until the flatbread edges are crisp.
Remove from the oven, slice, and serve hot.
